messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick thread for Priy's start on Mon 11/8. Need remote I-9, background check, laptop shipping, company email, and benefits kickoff. Who can own each?
Devin (HR): I'll handle I-9 and run the background check. Priy should complete Section 1 and upload ID scans before the verifier call.
hr-bot: I-9 portal link sent to priy@example.com — expires in 7 days. Verifier slots available Tue & Thu mornings.
Priy (newhire): Thanks! I have a passport, that should work, right? Also shipping address is 210 Cedar Ave, Unit 5, Seattle, WA 98109.
Devin (HR): Passport works fine (passport alone is acceptable). Please complete Section 1 today if possible.
Sam (IT): I'll take laptop + accounts. Need confirmed shipping address (got it) and to know whether to include external monitor. Also will create company email after People Ops confirms username.
Maya (People Ops): We'll create priy@redwood.com by Fri EOD and post it here. Monitor not necessary per manager note.
Lina (Hiring Manager): Please add Priy to eng-frontend, slack #eng-onboard, and schedule a team intro Wed 10am PT. No on-call first month.
CheckPoint-bot: Background check status: submitted. Typical turnaround 24-72 hours.
hr-bot: Reminder set: if I-9 not completed in 48h, automated ping to Priy + People Ops.
Priy (newhire): Completed Section 1 and uploaded passport images. Thanks!
CheckPoint-bot: Background check completed — clear. No findings.
Sam (IT): Provisioning snippet (internal):
```
create-device --model MacBookAir --owner priy@redwood.com
apply-mdm --profile dev
ship --address "210 Cedar Ave, Unit 5, Seattle, WA 98109" --carrier UPS
```
Shipment created: UPS tracking 1ZAAA1234567890123. ETA Fri.
Maya (People Ops): Action items recap: Devin = I-9 + bg-check; Sam = device + Okta + repo groups; Maya = email + calendar invites. Priy = join verifier call if scheduled. Welcome aboard! :tada:
